items.name: Fat Dragon Kung Pao chicken (consumed portion; leftovers subtracted)
items.portion: Approximately two-thirds of original pictured entree consumed; remaining mixed chicken/vegetables/sauce excluded
items.note: Original provisional full-entree estimate was 900 kcal, 70 g protein, 34 g carbs, 54 g fat, based on chicken, peanuts, vegetables, retained oil and house sauce; not restaurant nutrition or weighed food. Comparing the large original platter with the shallow leftover mound supports roughly one-third of the entree remaining. Subtracted estimated uneaten entree 300 kcal, 23 g protein, 11 g carbs and 18 g fat, yielding consumed 600 kcal, 47 g protein, 23 g carbs and 36 g fat (604 macro-kcal; rounding). Rice subtraction is separate, with sauce/oil assigned here to avoid double-counting. Correction: user explicitly reports "Leftover chicken and brown rice. About a half full standard takeout container. This is the part I didn't eat today." Inspected original photos img_390e822ab91e.jpeg and img_bbc96a349000.jpeg and leftover photos img_39891a0527ed.jpeg, img_6054ff1739c8.jpeg and img_48211bd63ed4.jpeg. The latter are THREE ANGLES OF ONE UNEATEN PORTION, not three portions. Half-full takeout container is not half the original platter plus rice bowl. The shallow mixed mound contains chicken, vegetables, peanuts, sauce and dispersed rice, with substantial container floor exposed. Working subtraction is 420 kcal total (300 entree + 120 rice); roughly 400-500 kcal is a plausible leftover working range, not measured nutrition. A smaller reasonable subtraction retains a higher-side consumed estimate. Container dimensions, hidden rice, oil and weights remain uncertain. Leftovers are excluded from November 3 intake and are not prelogged for tomorrow. Two dumplings remain the separately confirmed count so far, not an assumed final count; day remains incomplete.
